entries.title: PRISM
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a bold industrial design concept sheet of a compact tabletop SIX-LEGGED hobby servo robot with removable upper cockpit, not a huge cinematic machine. Exactly six legs, three per side, three rotary joints per leg, compact existing linkage proportions. Central body is broadened LEFT-TO-RIGHT, not stretched front-to-back. User requests a radically different exterior concept; prioritize a coherent genuinely new silhouette, not a palette swap of existing designs. This is conceptual exterior redesign: original screw/servo mounting islands should remain plausible unchanged local mechanisms underneath exterior shells; no invented new actuators. Printed shell panels visibly separable, intentional seams and accessible fasteners. Layout: landscape 3:2 concept board, left two thirds large fully visible front three-quarter hero, upper-right consistent top view with six legs visibly countable, lower-right same detachable cockpit standing on a small desktop dock. All views same design. Neutral pale gray studio backdrop, soft realistic product lighting, excellent readable material detail and full silhouette, no clutter. English title specified below, small 'EXTERIOR CONCEPT' subtitle. No dimensions or claims of mechanical validation. No phone, no humans, no weapons, no floating disconnected parts. Title: PRISM. Design: CYBER ORIGAMI. A spectacular low wide hexapod with folded geometric armor like architectural origami: asymmetric-looking faceting but bilateral mechanism symmetry, long crisp triangular white and cobalt blue planes, small acid yellow inserts, dark joints. Head is a low wedge-shaped detachable cockpit with a single broad smoked trapezoid face and two minimalist slit eyes, camera low center. Legs have radically angular folded-sheet silhouettes and large clean negative spaces; not the previous stock orange mecha panels. Broad shoulder-like central chassis, no weapons. Clean minimal surface detail, few deliberate panel seams.
